description: AgentOne is a desktop AI agent application that lets users run chats, connect AI model providers, and add built-in or MCP-based extensions. It also publishes an AI Model Directory website and downloadable model metadata catalog.
summary: AgentOne exposes a public HTTP JSON data surface for its AI Model Directory at `models.agent-one.dev`; the main `www.agent-one.dev` product and docs describe a desktop app that consumes third-party providers and MCP servers, but no documented developer API, GraphQL API, MCP endpoint, or CLI on the `agent-one.dev` domain was found.
